title: Married at 12. Now she runs a ₹900 crore company.
sources: DNA India - Kalpana Saroj profile, child marriage, abuse, and Kamani Tubes turnaround
Dutch Uncles - Kalpana Saroj biography and business profile
caption:
She was married off at 12 and worked as a tailor for daily wages. Today, her company is worth over 900 crore rupees.

Kalpana Saroj survived a child marriage, abuse and a suicide attempt before she was even a teenager. She rebuilt her life in Mumbai working as a tailor, then a furniture seller - before taking on Kamani Tubes, a company that was bankrupt and shut down and turning it around completely.

Her business empire today is worth roughly ₹900 crore (~$112 million).

There was no version of her story where this was expected. That's exactly why it's worth telling.
